'''Plescinia Entertainments''' was a major corporation that specialized in the production of [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] images for personal and commercial use. At least one of its [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojection]] products was advertised by [[Galladinium Galactic Exports]]' 50th annual publication of ''[[Galladinium's Galactic Datalog of Fantastic Technology]]''.<ref name="GFT" />
